$comment: P4.D367 — the image transport budget corpus (v4 `29c1e2690` at the `624d0d25c` pin), read by BOTH sides: `plan` rows drive v4's REAL `planImageTransport` (tsx leaf `image-transport-budget-plan.ts`) and v5's `plan_image_transport` under an explicit policy; `apply` rows drive v4's REAL `applyImageTransportBudget` (jest case `image-transport-budget.test.ts`, the two describers scripted by `scripts`, every other module real) and v5's `apply_image_transport_budget`. An attachment's `$dataLen: n` key is replaced IN PLACE by `data: 'A' x n` on both sides. A script is `{type, text?, error?}` or `{throw}`; an attachment with no script is described as `A description of <id>.`. Every row's `expect` (plan) is asserted on the v4 side so no row passes vacuously.

plan.label: plan_count_before_bytes
plan.rule: an image over BOTH the cap and the byte budget is a COUNT overflow (count is tested first)

plan.label: plan_bytes_skip_to_smaller
plan.rule: over the byte budget the walk CONTINUES: a smaller later image still fits

plan.label: plan_exact_fit
plan.rule: cost == bytesLeft is KEPT (strict >)

plan.label: plan_one_byte_over
plan.rule: one byte past what is left overflows on bytes

plan.label: plan_over_count_spends_no_bytes
plan.rule: an over-count image consumes no bytes (an equivalent mutant in the plan: count overflow is terminal)

plan.label: plan_provenance_beats_array_order
plan.rule: v4: uploads, then re-hydrated, then Lantern, whatever the array order

plan.label: plan_newest_of_a_kind_first
plan.rule: v4: the newest of a kind first

plan.label: plan_equal_created_at_array_order
plan.rule: equal createdAt ties break by array order

plan.label: plan_untagged_last
plan.rule: untagged ranks after every tagged one, in array order

plan.label: plan_v4_count_then_bytes_cap1
plan.rule: v4's row, cap 1: the upload first, then the cap

plan.label: plan_v4_count_then_bytes_cap4
plan.rule: v4's row, cap 4: the bytes skip past big-new to small-old

plan.label: plan_unreceivable_not_counted
plan.rule: an image the profile cannot receive takes capability and is NOT counted

plan.label: plan_receivable_non_image_keep
plan.rule: a receivable non-image is kept and never counted

plan.label: plan_unreceivable_non_image
plan.rule: a non-image the profile cannot receive takes capability

plan.label: plan_non_loaded_entries
plan.rule: an entry without a string id AND a string mimeType is not a loaded attachment

plan.label: plan_data_shapes
plan.rule: data.length: UTF-16 units for a string, elements for an array, 0 otherwise

plan.label: plan_max_images_zero
plan.rule: v4's maxImages 0 row: every image overflows on count

plan.label: plan_max_images_fifty
plan.rule: a cap of 50 keeps three

plan.label: plan_empty_array
plan.rule: no messages at all

plan.label: plan_no_attachments_key_and_empty
plan.rule: a message with no attachments key and one with []

plan.label: plan_two_messages
plan.rule: ranking spans messages; positions are per message

plan.label: plan_bug_151
plan.rule: v4's bug-151 row: four 500 KB uploads and six Lantern images under 4 MiB, newest kept

plan.label: plan_bug_151_cap_4
plan.rule: the same request at the default cap of 4: the uploads, then the cap

apply.label: apply_nothing_no_attachments
apply.rule: v4: no attachments → the same array, no line

apply.label: apply_nothing_reads_the_bytes
apply.rule: v4: a substitute that reads the bytes too → the same array, every image reported kept

apply.label: apply_bug106_described_key_dropped
apply.rule: v4: the bytes a text-only profile cannot read become a description and the key is DELETED

apply.label: apply_bug106_mixed_keep_and_describe
apply.rule: v4: keep what the profile reads beside what it cannot (a zip → unsupported → dropped)

apply.label: apply_bug106_non_loaded_passthrough
apply.rule: v4: a non-loaded entry is passed through untouched

apply.label: apply_bug106_extra_fields_carried
apply.rule: v4: every other field of a message rides through

apply.label: apply_bug106_attachment_free_alone
apply.rule: v4: attachment-free messages are left alone

apply.label: apply_capability_fallback_throws
apply.rule: v4: a capability fallback that THROWS → the WARN and the ⚠️ prefix

apply.label: apply_capability_unsupported_with_error
apply.rule: a capability fallback answering unsupported WITH an error → its own ⚠️ prefix, dropped, no WARN

apply.label: apply_overflow_describer_throws
apply.rule: v4: an overflow describer that THROWS → the WARN and the note

apply.label: apply_overflow_describer_unsupported
apply.rule: v4: a describer that cannot describe → the note, no WARN

apply.label: apply_cap_at_or_under
apply.rule: v4: at or under the cap → the same array

apply.label: apply_cap_four_of_six
apply.rule: v4: the first four of six untagged images sent, the other two described

apply.label: apply_cap_absent_reads_four
apply.rule: v4: no stored cap → the default of four

apply.label: apply_unreceivable_not_counted
apply.rule: v4: images the profile cannot receive take the ordinary fallback and are not counted

apply.label: apply_bytes_describe_or_omit
apply.rule: v4: a describable overflow is described, a non-describable one omitted with a note (no describer call)

apply.label: apply_describer_handed_stripped
apply.rule: v4: the describer is handed the attachment WITHOUT its transport tag

apply.label: apply_bug_151
apply.rule: v4: four 500 KB uploads and six Lantern images stay under the total, newest kept

apply.label: apply_capability_only_no_info
apply.rule: a capability-only call: the DEBUG fires, the INFO does not; a capability text result is reported described

apply.label: apply_vision_profile_provider_cannot_transport
apply.rule: a ticked vision box on a plugin that cannot transport images → capability for images

apply.label: apply_cap_edge_absent
apply.rule: resolveMaxImagesPerRequest over maxImagesPerRequest = '$absent' (5 images)

apply.label: apply_cap_edge_null
apply.rule: resolveMaxImagesPerRequest over maxImagesPerRequest = None (5 images)

apply.label: apply_cap_edge_zero
apply.rule: resolveMaxImagesPerRequest over maxImagesPerRequest = 0 (5 images)

apply.label: apply_cap_edge_one
apply.rule: resolveMaxImagesPerRequest over maxImagesPerRequest = 1 (5 images)

apply.label: apply_cap_edge_integral_float
apply.rule: resolveMaxImagesPerRequest over maxImagesPerRequest = 3.0 (5 images)

apply.label: apply_cap_edge_fraction
apply.rule: resolveMaxImagesPerRequest over maxImagesPerRequest = 2.5 (5 images)

apply.label: apply_cap_edge_fifty
apply.rule: resolveMaxImagesPerRequest over maxImagesPerRequest = 50 (5 images)

apply.label: apply_cap_edge_fifty_one
apply.rule: resolveMaxImagesPerRequest over maxImagesPerRequest = 51 (5 images)

apply.label: apply_cap_edge_string
apply.rule: resolveMaxImagesPerRequest over maxImagesPerRequest = '3' (5 images)

apply.label: apply_cap_edge_true
apply.rule: resolveMaxImagesPerRequest over maxImagesPerRequest = True (5 images)
